title: Mekton Blues
description: Saeder-Krupp industrial complex. Stolen military mech prototype telemetry is locked in the factory's data core. Get the data, clear resistance, and extract from the mech bay before reinforcements arrive.
briefing: Saeder-Krupp lifted a Mitsuhama prototype mech and trucked it to one of their black-flag factories outside the Sprawl. Mitsuhama is paying TOP dollar for the telemetry — schematics, weapon specs, neural-link config. Hit the warehouse entry, push through the assembly floor to the data core, pull the files. Then exfil from the mech bay before SK gets a Spider squad on-site. Heavy industrial security: drones, mech techs cross-trained in combat, and a corp mage running ICE on the data core. Watch for the mech itself in the bay — it's not active, but if SK techs power it up mid-extraction, you're done.
missionCompleteSummary: Mech telemetry delivered to Mitsuhama. SK is going to spend a year auditing how a Mitsuhama prototype ended up on their factory floor in the first place — that's their problem now. Big payday, lay low, the SK Spider squad will be looking for SOMEBODY to hang for this run.

rooms.title: Warehouse Entry
rooms._obstacleNote: Forklift, pallets, container, crates = WALLS (cannot walk through). Player paths down the central corridor between them.

rooms.title: Factory Floor
rooms._obstacleNote: Welding arms + press stations = WALLS. Data terminal at center is interactive (hex 5).

rooms.title: Mech Bay
rooms._obstacleNote: Mech occupies central columns y=6..9 (WALLS — impassable). Diagnostic stations at sides = COVER. Player must route around the mech via x=1 or x=5 corridor to reach the extraction at top.
